about: Labeled cases for the docs classifier. Each case rebuilds the shape of a real Claude Code docs change, trimmed to a few lines. `source` names the changelog entry or the docs page that the shape comes from. `label` is set by hand. `cited` is the rule that cites the block, or null for a block that no rule cites. A case with `removed: true` needs no model call.

cases.source: changelog: raised the skill listing cap from 250 to 1,536 characters
cases.heading: Frontmatter reference
cases.old:
### Frontmatter reference

| Field | Required | Description |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `description` | Recommended | What the skill does and when to use it. Put the key use case first: the combined `description` and `when_to_use` text is truncated at 250 characters in the skill listing to reduce context usage. |
| `when_to_use` | No | Additional context for when Claude should invoke the skill. Appended to `description` in the skill listing and counts toward the 250-character cap. |
cases.new:
### Frontmatter reference

| Field | Required | Description |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `description` | Recommended | What the skill does and when to use it. Put the key use case first: the combined `description` and `when_to_use` text is truncated at 1,536 characters in the skill listing to reduce context usage. |
| `when_to_use` | No | Additional context for when Claude should invoke the skill. Appended to `description` in the skill listing and counts toward the 1,536-character cap. |
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: changelog: added the `StopFailure` hook event
cases.heading: Hook lifecycle
cases.old:
## Hook lifecycle

| Event | When it fires |
| :- | :- |
| `SessionStart` | When a session begins or resumes |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | When you submit a prompt, before Claude processes it |
| `Stop` | When Claude finishes responding |
| `SessionEnd` | When a session terminates |
cases.new:
## Hook lifecycle

| Event | When it fires |
| :- | :- |
| `SessionStart` | When a session begins or resumes |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | When you submit a prompt, before Claude processes it |
| `Stop` | When Claude finishes responding |
| `StopFailure` | When the turn ends due to an API error |
| `SessionEnd` | When a session terminates |
cases.label: rule-update

cases.source: hooks page: `WorktreeCreate` also fires for a background session

cases.old:
## Hook lifecycle

| Event | When it fires |
| :- | :- |
| `WorktreeCreate` | When a worktree is being created via `--worktree` or `isolation: "worktree"`. Replaces default git behavior |
| `WorktreeRemove` | When a worktree is being removed at session exit |
cases.new:
## Hook lifecycle

| Event | When it fires |
| :- | :- |
| `WorktreeCreate` | When a worktree is being created via `--worktree`, `isolation: "worktree"`, or for a background session. Replaces default git behavior |
| `WorktreeRemove` | When a worktree is being removed at session exit, when a subagent finishes, or when you delete a background session |

cases.source: plugins troubleshooting page: the steps reworded
cases.heading: Hook loads but never fires
cases.old:
#### Hook loads but never fires

If a hook loads but never fires, check the event name. Event names are case-sensitive, so `PostToolUse` works and `postToolUse` does not. Then check the matcher.
cases.new:
#### Hook loads but never fires

If a hook loads without error but never fires, check its definition and then watch it run. Event names are case-sensitive, so confirm yours matches exactly, for example `PostToolUse`. Then confirm the hook's `matcher` matches the tool name.
cases.label: no-change

cases.heading: Commands
cases.old:
### Commands

A command is a single Markdown file the user runs by name.

<Note>
  Commands are the older format, and skills supersede them for new work. Keep `commands/` for files you're moving over from `.claude/commands/`.
</Note>
cases.new:
### Commands

A command is a single Markdown file the user runs by name.

<Note>
  Commands are a current format, equal to skills and not deprecated. Use a command for a single-file prompt, and a skill when you need supporting files.
</Note>
cases.label: rule-removal

cases.source: changelog: a `skills` entry in plugin.json hid the default `skills/` directory
cases.heading: How each key combines with its default location
cases.old:
### How each key combines with its default location

* **Replaces the default**: `commands`, `agents`, `skills`. When you set `commands`, the default `commands/` directory isn't scanned.
* **Merges**: `hooks`, `mcpServers`.
cases.new:
### How each key combines with its default location

* **Replaces the default**: `commands`, `agents`. When you set `commands`, the default `commands/` directory isn't scanned.
* **Adds to the default**: `skills`. The `skills/` directory is still scanned, and the listed directories load alongside it
* **Merges**: `hooks`, `mcpServers`.
cases.label: no-change

cases.source: changelog: added `effort`, `maxTurns` and `disallowedTools` frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents
cases.heading: Agent frontmatter
cases.new:
### Agent frontmatter

A plugin agent accepts these frontmatter fields: `name`, `description`, `model`, `effort`, `maxTurns`, `tools` and `disallowedTools`. `effort` takes `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`. Claude Code ignores any other field.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: changelog: plugins can declare `defaultEnabled: false` in plugin.json
cases.heading: defaultEnabled
cases.new:
### `defaultEnabled`

Set `defaultEnabled` to `false` in `plugin.json` to install the plugin turned off. The value must be a boolean. Dependencies of enabled plugins are still enabled.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: skills page: `compatibility` accepts a string of up to 500 characters
cases.heading: Using skill frontmatter outside Claude Code
cases.new:
### Using skill frontmatter outside Claude Code

The `compatibility` field accepts a string of up to 500 characters. Claude Code accepts the field but doesn't act on it.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.source: ruling 8 on #25: a cited section moves under a new heading
cases.heading: Hooks field
cases.new:
### Hooks field

`hooks` takes a `.json` file path, an inline hooks object in the same shape as `hooks` in `settings.json`, or an array mixing both. Event names are case-sensitive. Claude Code merges whatever you declare with `hooks/hooks.json` when that file exists.
cases.label: new-rule

cases.heading: Hook output
cases.new:
### Hook output

When a hook prints more than 10,000 characters, Claude Code saves the output to a file and puts a 2,000-character preview with the file path into context.
cases.label: no-change
